description: Creates a timed or all-day Google Calendar event and returns it under response_data, without conflict checking. send_updates defaults to "all", which emails all attendees; for eligible event types, the organizer is added unless excluded and a Google Meet link is requested by default.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Exclusive end date for an all-day event in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be provided together with start_date and be later than start_date.

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location of the event as free-form text.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name from the timezone database (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Jerusalem', 'UTC'). Required if datetime is naive. For recurring events, start and end must include a timeZone. If not provided, UTC is used. If datetime includes timezone info (Z or offset), this field is optional and defaults to UTC. IMPORTANT: Must be a valid IANA timezone identifier. Values like 'EST', 'PST', 'ISRAEL TIME', or other abbreviations are NOT valid IANA timezone names.

attendees.title: Attendees
attendees.description: List of attendees. Each attendee can be either: (1) A string email address (e.g., 'user@example.com'), or (2) An object with 'email' (required), 'optional' (boolean, default false), 'displayName' (string), 'comment' (string), 'additionalGuests' (integer), and 'resource' (boolean). To mark an attendee as optional (not required), use object format: {'email': 'user@example.com', 'optional': true}. IMPORTANT: Only valid email addresses are accepted. Plain names cannot be used.

eventType.title: Event Type
eventType.description: Type of the event, immutable post-creation. 'workingLocation' (REQUIRES Google Workspace Enterprise). Note: 'fromGmail' events cannot be created via API.

recurrence.title: Recurrence
recurrence.description: List of RRULE, EXRULE, RDATE, EXDATE lines for recurring events. Supported frequencies: DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY. For recurring events, start.timeZone and end.timeZone must be present. UNTIL values follow RFC 5545: date-only (YYYYMMDD) for all-day events, or UTC datetime with Z suffix (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ) for timed events. UNTIL values with time but missing Z suffix are auto-corrected. Provide an empty list to remove recurrence so the event becomes non-recurring.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive start date for an all-day event in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be provided together with end_date and without start_datetime or end_datetime.

calendar_id.title: Calendar Id
calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. Use 'primary' (recommended) for the user's main calendar. Alternatively, use a calendar ID from the user's accessible calendar list. Calendar IDs look like email addresses (e.g., 'xyz@group.calendar.google.com' for shared calendars). Important: Arbitrary email addresses will NOT work - the calendar must exist in the user's calendar list with appropriate access permissions. Use GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS to retrieve valid calendar IDs.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: The calendar where you want to create the event. Use 'primary' (recommended) for your main calendar. For other calendars, use a calendar ID from your accessible calendar list - not an arbitrary email address.

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the event. Can contain HTML. Optional. Must be omitted for 'birthday' event type.

end_datetime.title: End Datetime
end_datetime.description: Event end time in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. When provided, this parameter takes precedence over event_duration_hour and event_duration_minutes. If not provided, the end time is calculated using start_datetime + duration. Must be after start_datetime. Explicit timezone information (Z or an offset) is preserved; offset-less values are interpreted in `timezone`, or UTC when it is omitted.

send_updates.title: SendUpdates
send_updates.description: Options for who should receive notifications about event changes.

start_datetime.title: Start Datetime
start_datetime.description: Event start time in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. Required for timed events; omit it when using start_date and end_date for an all-day event.

guestsCanModify.title: Guests Can Modify
guestsCanModify.description: If True, guests can modify the event.

exclude_organizer.title: Exclude Organizer
exclude_organizer.description: If True, the organizer will NOT be added as an attendee. Default is False (organizer is included).
exclude_organizer.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to include yourself (the organizer) as an attendee. Turn this on if you don't want to appear as a guest or receive attendee notifications.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of birthday event: 'birthday', 'anniversary', or 'other'. Defaults to 'birthday'.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Contact ID in format 'people/c12345' from Google People API. REQUIRED when type is 'anniversary' or 'other'. MUST BE OMITTED when type is 'birthday' (the API forbids contact field for type='birthday').

customTypeName.title: Custom Type Name
customTypeName.description: Custom type name when type is 'other'. Requires valid contact field.

create_meeting_room.title: Create Meeting Room
create_meeting_room.description: Defaults to True. When True, for CREATE operations creates a Google Meet link; for UPDATE operations preserves existing conference data if present, or adds a new Meet link if none exists. Google Workspace accounts will successfully receive a Meet link. Personal Gmail accounts and other unsupported accounts will gracefully fallback to creating an event without a Meet link when conference creation fails. Set to False to skip Meet link operations (won't create new or modify existing conference data). The fallback ensures event creation succeeds even when conference features are unavailable due to account limitations.

event_duration_hour.title: Event Duration Hour
event_duration_hour.description: Number of hours for the event duration. Supports multi-day events (e.g., 240 hours = 10 days). For durations under 1 hour, use event_duration_minutes instead. Ignored if end_datetime is provided.

extended_properties.title: Extended Properties
extended_properties.description: Extended properties of the event for storing custom metadata. Contains 'private' (visible only on this calendar) and/or 'shared' (visible to all attendees) dictionaries mapping string keys to string values. Example: {'private': {'key1': 'value1'}, 'shared': {'key2': 'value2'}}

focusTimeProperties.title: FocusTimeProperties

chatStatus.title: ChatStatus
chatStatus.description: Chat status during focus time: 'active' or 'doNotDisturb'.

declineMessage.title: Decline Message
declineMessage.description: Message to include in declined meeting invitations. Only used when autoDeclineMode is set.

autoDeclineMode.title: AutoDeclineMode
autoDeclineMode.description: Auto decline mode: 'declineNone' (no invitations declined), 'declineAllConflictingInvitations' (all conflicting invitations declined), or 'declineOnlyNewConflictingInvitations' (only new conflicting invitations declined).

focusTimeProperties.description: Properties for focusTime events. REQUIRES Google Workspace Enterprise account with Focus Time feature enabled.

guestsCanInviteOthers.title: Guests Can Invite Others
guestsCanInviteOthers.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite others to the event.

declineMessage.title: Decline Message
declineMessage.description: Message to include in declined meeting invitations. Only used when autoDeclineMode is set.

autoDeclineMode.title: AutoDeclineMode
autoDeclineMode.description: Auto decline mode: 'declineNone' (no invitations declined), 'declineAllConflictingInvitations' (all conflicting invitations declined), or 'declineOnlyNewConflictingInvitations' (only new conflicting invitations declined). RECURRING EVENT RESTRICTION: For recurring out-of-office events, ONLY 'declineOnlyNewConflictingInvitations' is allowed. Cannot use 'declineAllConflictingInvitations' for recurring OOO (Google Calendar prevents retroactively declining existing meetings). REQUIRES Google Workspace (paid business subscription, e.g., Business Starter at $6/user/month). Personal Gmail accounts cannot use this feature.

event_duration_minutes.title: Event Duration Minutes
event_duration_minutes.description: Duration in minutes (0-59 ONLY). NEVER use 60+ minutes - use event_duration_hour=1 instead. Maximum value is 59. Combined duration (hours + minutes) must be greater than 0. Ignored if end_datetime is provided.

guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.title: Guests Can See Other Guests
guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can see who the event's attendees are.

workingLocationProperties.title: WorkingLocationProperties

homeOffice.title: WorkingLocationHomeOffice
homeOffice.description:
Empty object marker for home office working location.

This is used to indicate the user is working from home.
Google Calendar API accepts an empty object for this field.

customLocation.title: WorkingLocationCustom

label.title: Label
label.description: Label for a custom working location (e.g., 'Client site').

customLocation.description: Custom working location with a display label.

label.title: Label
label.description: Office name displayed in Calendar clients (e.g., building name).

buildingId.title: Building Id
buildingId.description: Optional building identifier from org Resources.

workingLocationProperties.description:
Properties for workingLocation events. REQUIRES Google Workspace Enterprise.

Constraints discovered from testing:
- Must set transparency='transparent' and visibility='public'
- Description must be omitted
- Depending on 'type', include one of 'homeOffice', 'officeLocation', or 'customLocation'

width.title: Width
width.description: Width of the gadget in pixels. Deprecated.

height.title: Height
height.description: Height of the gadget in pixels. Deprecated.

display.title: Display
display.description: Display mode of the gadget. Deprecated.

iconLink.title: Icon Link
iconLink.description: URL of the gadget icon. Deprecated.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Gadget preferences as key-value pairs. Deprecated.

url.title: Url
url.description: URL of the event source. Must be absolute.

id.title: Id
id.description: The attendee's Profile ID, if available.

self.title: Self
self.description: Whether this entry represents the calendar where the event appears.

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: Whether the attendee is a resource (for example, a room). Can only be set when adding the attendee initially.

organizer.title: Organizer
organizer.description: Whether the attendee is the organizer. Read-only.

additionalGuests.title: Additional Guests
additionalGuests.description: Number of additional guests the attendee is bringing.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: If 'useDefault' is false, the list of reminders that override the default.

useDefault.title: Use Default
useDefault.description: Whether the default reminders of the calendar apply to the event.

fileId.title: File Id
fileId.description: ID of the attached file. For Google Drive files, the Drive file ID. Read-only.

iconLink.title: Icon Link
iconLink.description: URL link to the attachment's icon.

accessCode.title: Access Code
accessCode.description: Access code to access the conference.

regionCode.title: Region Code
regionCode.description: CLDR/ISO 3166 region code for the country (e.g., 'SE' for Sweden). Populated for phone entry points only.

meetingCode.title: Meeting Code
meetingCode.description: Meeting code to access the conference.

entryPointFeatures.title: Entry Point Features
entryPointFeatures.description: Features of the entry point (e.g., 'toll', 'toll-free'). One entry point can have multiple features.

id.title: Id
id.description: The participant's Profile ID, if available.

self.title: Self
self.description: Whether this participant corresponds to the calendar on which this copy of the event appears.

date.title: Date
date.description: The date, in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format, for all-day events.

dateTime.title: Date Time
dateTime.description: The start/end time as a combined date-time value (RFC3339).

timeZone.title: Time Zone
timeZone.description: The time zone for the start/end time.

entryPoints.title: Entry Points
entryPoints.description: Information about individual conference entry points (e.g., video, phone).

conferenceId.title: Conference Id
conferenceId.description: ID of the conference (e.g., meeting code for Google Meet).

createRequest.title: Create Request
createRequest.description: Request to generate a new conference.

label.title: Label
label.description: Label for the custom working location.

deskId.title: Desk Id
deskId.description: Desk ID within the floor section.

method.title: Method
method.description: The method used by the reminder (e.g., 'email', 'popup').

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: Number of minutes before the start of the event when the reminder should trigger.

name.title: Name
name.description: User-visible name of the conference solution (e.g., 'Google Meet').

iconUri.title: Icon Uri
iconUri.description: URI to the icon of the conference solution.

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: Properties shared between copies of the event on other attendees' calendars. A map of string keys to string values.

private.title: Private
private.description: Properties private to the copy of the event on this calendar. A map of string keys to string values.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view the event in Google Calendar web UI. Extracted from the API response htmlLink field.

composio_execution_message.title: Composio Execution Message
composio_execution_message.description: Informational message about the execution, such as fallback behavior when conference creation is unavailable.

statusCode.title: Status Code
statusCode.description: Status of the conference creation request: 'pending', 'success', or 'failure'.

chatStatus.title: Chat Status
chatStatus.description: Chat status during focus time: 'available' or 'doNotDisturb'.

declineMessage.title: Decline Message
declineMessage.description: Custom message sent when declining meeting requests.

end.title: End
end.description: The (exclusive) end time of the event.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Type of the resource. Always 'calendar#event' for an event.

start.title: Start
start.description: The (inclusive) start time of the event.

gadget.title: Gadget
gadget.description: A gadget that extends the event. Deprecated.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Whether this is a locked event copy where no changes can be made to main event fields. Read-only.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source from which the event was created.

colorId.title: Color Id
colorId.description: The color of the event. This is an ID referring to an entry in the 'eventColors' dictionary in the Colors resource.

created.title: Created
created.description: Creation time of the event (RFC3339 timestamp).

iCalUID.title: I Cal Uid
iCalUID.description: Event identifier as defined in RFC5545. Shared by all instances of a recurring event, different from 'id'.

updated.title: Updated
updated.description: Last modification time of the event (RFC3339 timestamp).

htmlLink.title: Html Link
htmlLink.description: An absolute link to this event in the Google Calendar Web UI.

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location of the event as free-form text.

recurrence.title: Recurrence
recurrence.description: List of RRULE/EXRULE/EXDATE/RDATE lines for a recurring event following RFC5545.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view this event in Google Calendar web UI. Auto-populated from htmlLink.

hangoutLink.title: Hangout Link
hangoutLink.description: An absolute link to the Google Hangout (legacy) associated with this event. Read-only.

privateCopy.title: Private Copy
privateCopy.description: Whether this is a private event copy where changes are not shared with other copies on other calendars.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar ('opaque' blocks, 'transparent' does not).

conferenceData.title: Conference Data
conferenceData.description: Information about a conference attached to the event (e.g., Google Meet).

guestsCanModify.title: Guests Can Modify
guestsCanModify.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can modify the event.

anyoneCanAddSelf.title: Anyone Can Add Self
anyoneCanAddSelf.description: Whether anyone can invite themselves to the event. Deprecated.

attendeesOmitted.title: Attendees Omitted
attendeesOmitted.description: Whether attendees may have been omitted from the event's representation.

recurringEventId.title: Recurring Event Id
recurringEventId.description: ID of the recurring event to which this instance belongs.

originalStartTime.title: Original Start Time
originalStartTime.description: For an instance of a recurring event, the original start time of the instance.

endTimeUnspecified.title: End Time Unspecified
endTimeUnspecified.description: Whether the end time is unspecified.

focusTimeProperties.title: Focus Time Properties
focusTimeProperties.description: Properties for focus time events. Present when eventType='focusTime'.

guestsCanInviteOthers.title: Guests Can Invite Others
guestsCanInviteOthers.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite others.

outOfOfficeProperties.title: Out Of Office Properties
outOfOfficeProperties.description: Properties for out-of-office events. Present when eventType='outOfOffice'.

guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.title: Guests Can See Other Guests
guestsCanSeeOtherGuests.description: Whether attendees other than the organizer can see who the event's attendees are.

workingLocationProperties.title: Working Location Properties
workingLocationProperties.description: Properties for working location events. Present when eventType='workingLocation'.

declineMessage.title: Decline Message
declineMessage.description: Custom message sent when declining meeting requests.

status.title: Status
status.description: Status of the conference creation request.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Client-generated unique ID for the conference creation request.

conferenceSolutionKey.title: Conference Solution Key
conferenceSolutionKey.description: Key identifying the conference solution to use.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
